interview.hardest_part: Precise team coordination with AI survivors through the hotel corridors, managing hordes of common infected while avoiding or handling special infected without falling off ledges or getting pinned down during door openings and elevator sequences
interview.likely_failure: Failing to progress past the initial hotel sections due to poor aiming under pressure, running out of ammo during fights, or dying once and losing time before reaching the first safe room milestone
interview.helpful_mechanics: Easy difficulty setting, cooperative AI teammates who tank damage and push enemies, variety of weapons and items that can be switched quickly, and the ability to shove and use environmental objects
interview.harmful_mechanics: Aggressive infected AI behavior requiring constant vigilance, limited health/ammo management on a tight route, need for precise timing on elevators and safe room doors, and risk of revives interrupting momentum
